Progetto NINFEA and NINFEA project were found only in COHO; a paper uses the differently capitalised Progetto Ninfea, which is not evidence for the requested uppercase variant. The website URL in the batch was not cached.

label: Rhea Study

label: Rhea Study
detail: The profile is cached only as its title. The catalogue supplies the young-adulthood follow-up plan and obesity rationale. All four batch-listed profile/naming papers were read; applications include prenatal chemicals and childhood adiposity, thyroid function and birth outcomes, and maternal sleep and fetal growth.

label: Rhea Study
detail: The catalogue describes recruitment and Mediterranean-diet background rather than a programme-purpose statement. The cited analysis papers and additional cohort mentions describe specific applications. The environmental/genetic-design sentence in a multicohort supplement belongs to Generation R, not RHEA. The cohort profile (DOI:10.1093/ije/dyx084) has only a short unusable cache entry.

label: Rotterdam Study III
detail: The 2020 profile is internally inconsistent about the main age range: its baseline-examination caption says mainly 45–60, while its explicit 2006-extension paragraph says 45–54. The definition follows the latter. Parent-study design and purpose apply to this third recruitment cohort. The cohort III word-order variant was not found outside COHO; catalogue evidence supplies the third-cohort catalogue names.

label: Suivi de l'Exposition à la Pollution Atmosphérique durant la Grossesse et Effets sur la Santé
detail: CNRS having an explicit role in setting up the cohort.

label: Suivi de l'Exposition à la Pollution Atmosphérique durant la Grossesse et Effets sur la Santé
detail: The cohort website explicitly describes intensive repeat personal monitoring and biological collection twice during pregnancy and repeatedly in the first years of life. The protocol calls SEPAGES a research platform. Straight/curly apostrophe label variants share the same source quote under the typography rule.

label: Suivi de l'Exposition à la Pollution Atmosphérique durant la Grossesse et Effets sur la Santé
detail: The cohort website identifies Inserm and University Grenoble Alpes as coordinators. The catalogue and focused paper search locate CNRS in affiliations but do not state a founding role.

label: Sysdimet study
detail: weak: reference-list title

label: Sysdimet study
detail: The catalogue describes the diets as representing a healthy Nordic diet. The paper specifies men and women in its inclusion criteria; trial recruitment was through local newspaper advertisements in the Kuopio area. The registry page is a cached stub; both long registry names remain unverified after a cache grep.

label: Finnish Maternity Cohort
detail: The profile states screening is offered to all women, but participation is virtually rather than literally complete (94% reported). The example paper independently places FMC within Northern Finland Biobank Borealis and dates samples to 1983–2016, including early second-trimester as well as late first-trimester samples.

label: Polish-Norwegian Study
detail: The profile explicitly supports health and health-related behaviour aims (name quote), and the example reports recruitment of men and women. A newer cached multi-cohort supplement calls it the Polish Cohort Study, formerly the Polish-Norwegian Study.

label: Monitoring Project on Risk Factors for Chronic Diseases
detail: weak: reference-list title; no standalone use located

label: Monitoring Project on Risk Factors for Chronic Diseases

label: Monitoring Project on Risk Factors for Chronic Diseases
detail: The RIVM history explicitly assigns this expanded scope to the MORGEN project in 1993–1997.

label: Generation R Next Study
detail: Both additional naming papers were read. PMID:40311909 identifies Generation R Next as part of the Generation R Study Programme and studies fertility/miscarriage among women and men, supporting parental health research. The catalogue identifies Erasmus MC as lead organisation.

label: Nordic Children and Adults Born Preterm
detail: The current website explicitly identifies Oulu as data controller and lists linked health, social-benefit and population registers. The paper includes parental hospitalizations and socioeconomic/education data. The website describes two studies under NORDCAP; the defined all-births population is one register cohort, while the narrower 1987–1990 study needs scope clarification if the term denotes the entire project. The catalogue inconsistently gives 1986 in structured fields and 1987 in its description; the website and paper support 1987. Finnish synonym not found after exact cache grep.

label: Wearable data collection study
detail: Healthy status, enrollment specifically by the University of Oulu, follow-up of at least four months, repeated biological sampling, and urine collection.

label: Wearable data collection study
detail: Both cited data records, including DOI lookup, are absent from the cache. Exact grep found neither alternate name outside COHO. The catalogue lists Oulu among additional organisations, which does not establish who enrolled participants. The 2021 HEAP paper describes a planned pilot among pregnant women in an HPV vaccination subset; it cannot establish that this later broader cohort actually followed that precise plan.

label: Wearable data collection study
detail: The catalogue describes a longitudinal pregnant/non-pregnant women's cohort and lists Oulu as an additional organisation, but does not establish these details. A focused cached-paper search did not resolve them.

label: Kardiovize Brno 2030
detail: The methods paper defines a prospective cohort; the later paper calls its baseline analysis cross-sectional but explicitly states the population is being followed. The 1% describes the sampling target, not a fixed participant count. Exact grep found no Kardiovize Brno 2030 Project use outside COHO.

label: 1970 British Cohort Study
detail: weak: reference-list title

label: 1970 British Cohort Study
detail: The profile states that the Centre for Longitudinal Studies at University College London houses the 1970 cohort; the catalogue explicitly supplies management and core funding. British Births Survey quote is clipped before personal names.

label: Study on the influence of Air pollution on Lung function, Inflammation and Ageing
detail: Explicit operational management of SALIA by IUF – Leibniz Research Institute for Environmental Medicine.

label: Study on the influence of Air pollution on Lung function, Inflammation and Ageing
detail: The example paper explicitly describes SALIA as population-based and longitudinal. All three missing names were searched exactly across the cache; their case/punctuation variants were not found outside COHO. The definition-source abbreviation list has lowercase air pollution and lacks the comma, rather than the listed uppercase Air version. The newer supplement corroborates the North-Rhine Westphalia government programme.

label: Study on the influence of Air pollution on Lung function, Inflammation and Ageing
detail: The new catalogue entry does not name the institute. The focused paper search finds the institute in affiliations, which does not establish management.

label: NoMa study
detail: The long Effect of fat quality name is the external catalogue’s record title. The University of Oslo project page uses both NoMa study and NOMA study, and the paper confirms the precise trial dates and design.

label: National Health and Nutrition Survey – HYDRIA
detail: The cross-sectional design is explicit in both papers. The 2022 paper’s authors are affiliated to the Hellenic Health Foundation, which also co-funded the survey, held its data centrally and provided ethics approval. It describes interviewer-administered questionnaires, clinical measurements and blood sampling.

label: Grain Fibre Modification for Gut-mediated Health Effects
detail: The trial paper’s affiliations include the University of Eastern Finland and VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland. The catalogue links FEF and the lowercase expanded title directly to the 2014 design paper and gives 2011 collection. The trial-registry cache is a short stub, so its title variants could not be verified there. PMID:31136658 independently identifies NCT03550365 as the rye-bread crossover trial. FEF uses for pulmonary flow or brain regions are unrelated.

label: Piccolipiù birth cohort
detail: The later paper confirms realised recruitment through March 2015; the protocol had anticipated recruitment throughout 2014. Umbilical cord tissue and heel blood spots are also explicitly described in the protocol. Progetto Piccolipiù is the project’s participant Facebook-page name.

label: Foods for weight management
detail: The trial running from 2008 through 2010.

label: Foods for weight management
detail: The 2012 paper’s affiliation supplies the Institute of Public Health and Clinical Nutrition, University of Eastern Finland. The four search-added papers were checked: PMID:27515906 gives the full registry identifier; PMID:25003530 names a Finnish obese weight-loss sample by that identifier; the dairy/preload reviews did not yield the missing names. The later example paper confirms registry identifier 67529475.

label: Foods for weight management
detail: The catalogue's date field gives data collection in 2008–2009; a focused cached-paper search does not establish 2008–2010. The cached ISRCTN URL remains a cookies/JavaScript stub, so trial dates cannot be read from it.

label: Constances
detail: The original paper specifies selected Health Screening Centres across France, and the later paper confirms examination-centre recruitment and four-yearly medical exams. The catalogue explicitly lists Inserm as lead organisation and supplies the French expanded name. The source population initially excluded agricultural and self-employed workers insured by other funds.

label: Gene and Environment: Prospective Study on Infancy in Italy
detail: The 2021 main paper documents childhood follow-up around age four. Its supplement instead describes GASPII as a national multicentre study in Rome and Bologna, while the 2007 abstract and 2014 cohort description explicitly concern Rome. Curator should distinguish the Rome cohort from the broader national programme named in that supplement. Catalogue-style IT-GASPII and exact lowercase/short expanded names were not found.

label: Gene and Environment: Prospective Study on Infancy in Italy
detail: The quote is the GASPII row in a published review's cohort table.

label: Kaunas cohort
detail: The 2018 HELIX paper explicitly lists KANC among its six participating longitudinal birth cohorts. It misspells Kaunas as Kaunus in that list; the exact label is confirmed by the catalogue. Recruitment is described as 2007–2008 in the early/HELIX papers and 2007–2009 in the later child follow-up; the definition only states the start year.

label: Central European Longitudinal Studies of Parents and Children: Young Adults
detail: The website’s Czech text also describes linking new and historical data to early disease indicators, questionnaires on health/nutrition/lifestyle/environment/psychology/sociodemography, and clinical examinations. The paper’s affiliations place RECETOX at Masaryk University in Brno. The hyphenated acronym is used in the external catalogue; the paper uses CELSPAC: YA.

label: European Longitudinal Study of Pregnancy and Childhood
detail: The cohort profile additionally documents obstetric/paediatric medical records and face-to-face physical/mental examinations, plus maternal recruitment during pregnancy. The definition denotes the Czech arm; the generic ELSPAC name also names the parent international programme.

label: Perturbateurs Endocriniens: Étude Longitudinale sur les Anomalies de la Grossesse, l’Infertilité et l’Enfance
detail: Follow-up of PELAGIE children into young adulthood.

label: Perturbateurs Endocriniens: Étude Longitudinale sur les Anomalies de la Grossesse, l’Infertilité et l’Enfance
detail: INSERM U625 and Rennes are explicit affiliations of the 2011 cohort-paper authors. The capitalised Endocriniens label is the catalogue title; the paper uses lower-case endocriniens. The added 2015 and 2017 papers confirm childhood pyrethroid/developmental investigations, while the 2023 Brazilian exposure paper only cites PELAGIE. The accented acronym was not found outside COHO.

label: Perturbateurs Endocriniens: Étude Longitudinale sur les Anomalies de la Grossesse, l’Infertilité et l’Enfance
detail: The new catalogue descriptions explicitly report follow-up through age 12; the listed paper and focused cached-paper search do not document young-adult follow-up.

label: Generation XXI
detail: The website explicitly includes maternal/parental assessments and cardiovascular risk markers as study interests, beyond the six quotes. The 2026 paper thanks the enrolled families. Portuguese and English names, and Arabic/Roman numerals, are all documented; G21 is the external catalogue code.

label: Moli-sani Study
detail: The project website identifies the sampling frame as Family-based random sample and the starting point as city registries of 30 Molise towns. It documents baseline screening and follow-up endpoints including neurodegenerative disease. The three search-added papers were checked; the 2016 review confirms genetic/environmental cardiovascular, cerebrovascular and cancer interests, while the other two cached papers contain only abstracts and short publisher stubs. These are not treated as unreadable for claims already covered by the sources above.

label: Central European Longitudinal Studies of Parents and Children: The Next Generation
detail: The 2024 paper explicitly identifies 2015–2016 recruitment as the pilot phase. The website lists environment, lifestyle, nutrition, genetics and gut bacteria as factors studied; the catalogue names RECETOX as lead organisation. The catalogue gives 2018 as its collection start, whereas the current project website explicitly gives 2017. Different published planned sizes refer to the overall cohort; no size is asserted in the COHO definition.

label: Cypriot Children's Health and Environment Observatory
detail: The paper’s affiliations explicitly identify Cyprus University of Technology and biobank.cy at University of Cyprus. Its methods describe classroom air monitoring, residential/home exposure questionnaires and environmental measurements. Both acronyms name the multi-country programme in the paper; the definition denotes its Cyprus site. The catalogue explicitly identifies a Cyprus collection as CHILDREN FIRST / CHILDREN HEALTH AND ENVIRONMENT OBSERVATORY. The long Cypriot label and Greek name were not found, and both project website URLs are absent from the cache. Future annual procedures are protocol commitments, not completed follow-up.

label: Observation of Cardiovascular Risks and Health in Luxembourg
detail: The official LIH page states residents of the Grand Duchy, while the 2021 paper explicitly describes adult residents. The 2019 article identifies the added survey as EHES-LUX. ORISCAV-LUX-II is the catalogue entry specifically for the 2016–2018 second wave; the definition and other acronyms span the broader two-wave programme, so its scope should be reviewed. Paper labels often abbreviate the periods as 2007–2008 and 2016–2017; LIH gives the full fieldwork periods used in the definition.

label: Barcelona Life Study Cohort
detail: The 2025 air-pollution paper confirms the prospective cohort and precise enrolment dates (October 16, 2018–April 14, 2021). The cohort profile is cached only as a title, so broader purpose and primary-care-centre details are quoted from the project website; the 2026 study corroborates the hospital and recruitment details.

label: Puberty and metabolic risk in obese children. Epigenetic alterations and pathophysiological and diagnostic implications
detail: Affiliations explicitly identify Santiago de Compostela and Spain; the methods’ centre approval list identifies all four locations. The later 2026 PUBMEP paper (PMID:41736036) independently documents paired prepubertal/pubertal blood sampling and insulin-resistance DNA-methylation analyses. The full English label is the university project title.

label: Study of Secondary Exposure to Pesticides among Children, Adolescents, and Adults
detail: The plural Exposures/Across expanded name is the catalogue’s entry title. The project website uses ESPINA Study and reports completed 2024 ancillary follow-up, while the 2025 paper documents 2016 and 2022 examinations. The newer AChE paper is cached as PDF/PMC HTML and was checked; its absent XML URL was not needed.

label: Rome Longitudinal Study
detail: weak: Found in a cited paper title in the reference list.

label: Rome Longitudinal Study
detail: The 2022 paper and two 2019 papers support occupational, social and environmental health analyses and explicitly affiliate the cohort team to Department of Epidemiology, Lazio Regional Health Service, ASL Roma 1. Original methods call the 2001 population a fixed cohort; the catalogue’s ROLS entry instead denotes the 2011 census population. Curator should confirm whether the term is intended to span both census implementations. The 2023 paper is cached only as an abstract and publisher stubs; its abstract confirms a 2011 Rome census sample but does not name RoLS.

label: Prevention Cube
detail: The papers use PRECUBE; the full descriptive name and employer-selection rule are stated by the catalogue. The 2015 paper is cached only as an abstract, so its full text is needed for the legal surveillance requirement. Observation counts and paper-specific employee samples are not cohort totals.

label: Prevention Cube
detail: The immediately preceding sentence identifies the IDEWE ethics approval for PRECUBE.

label: Czech Health, Alcohol and Psychosocial factors In Eastern Europe study
detail: The contemporary paper supports the original Czech sampling and gives the place names without diacritics; the catalogue supplies later administrative and exposome linkage. Both listed cohort-naming papers were searched, followed by one case-sensitive whole-cache search for missing names. The full regional label and Czech HAPIEE cohort appeared only in COHO.

label: Czech Health, Alcohol and Psychosocial factors In Eastern Europe study
detail: The sentence is under the HAPIEE funding description in the supplement.

label: International Lipid-Based Nutrient Supplements Project-DYAD-Malawi
detail: Single-blind trial design, a nine-year child follow-up, and an explicit operational partnership between University of Malawi College of Medicine and Tampere University.

label: International Lipid-Based Nutrient Supplements Project-DYAD-Malawi
detail: All eight listed accession-citing papers and three additional cohort-naming papers were searched before leaving the follow-up/name claims unsupported. The exact hyphenated iLiNS-DYAD-Malawi variant was not found externally; PMID:35149871 uses iLiNS-DYAD Malawi with a space. The ClinicalTrials.gov page is a short stub and its API record is absent. PMID:25646337's abstract explicitly tests newborn size but its full text is absent. PMID:30775005 places these trials in the International Lipid-Based Nutrient Supplements Project. Review the catalogue's combined DOSE/DYAD tag against this term's narrower Malawi DYAD identity.

label: International Lipid-Based Nutrient Supplements Project-DYAD-Malawi
detail: wrong: The trial papers describe partial double-blinding and state that SQ-LNS recipients were not blinded, rather than giving the definition's single-blind description. The new catalogue, listed paper and additional cached papers do not establish nine-year follow-up or operational institutional responsibility; the trial registry cache is only a short placeholder.

label: New Hampshire Birth Cohort Study
detail: The own-study website explicitly states early-pregnancy-to-childhood follow-up. The primary paper measures arsenic in home well water and maternal biomarkers and evaluates maternal glucose outcomes, supporting the definition's example environmental exposure.

label: Shanghai Dapuqiao Aging and Cognition Study
detail: Age conflict requires review: the catalogue says ≥65 years, while the cited primary paper says ≥60 for the 2019 sample of 2,287. The paper does not use SDACS or its expanded name; those names and the multiwave open-cohort description are supplied by the catalogue. The definition acknowledges the predominantly cross-sectional nature.

label: Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe
detail: Additional support beyond six quotes: the Wave 1 page says eleven European countries contributed baseline data in 2004 and Israel joined late that year; Wave 7 achieved full EU coverage in 2017. The profile includes Switzerland and tables on cognition and employment. The infrastructure page dates Munich coordination to 2023. SHARE's panel population and its ERIC legal infrastructure are related scopes in this definition.

label: Harmonized Diagnostic Assessment of Dementia for the Longitudinal Aging Study in India
detail: Additional support beyond six quotes: PMID:39482079 calls LASI-DAD nationally representative and lists neurodegenerative biomarkers and environmental exposures. PMID:40838581 explicitly says LASI-DAD implements HCAP. The overview describes informant interviews, geriatric tests, whole-genome sequencing and environmental assessments; the design page describes MRI. The methods paper at PMC7398273 explicitly calls it a collaborative project led from USC and AIIMS New Delhi, with Indian regional centers.

label: Hokkaido Study on Environment and Children's Health
detail: Explicit operational leadership of the Hokkaido Study by the Center for Environmental and Health Sciences of Hokkaido University.

label: Hokkaido Study on Environment and Children's Health
detail: The named study consists of two separately recruited prospective birth cohorts. Review cohort aggregation for this umbrella term, with Sapporo and Hokkaido as cohort members.

label: Hokkaido Study on Environment and Children's Health
detail: Additional support beyond six quotes: the methods describe prenatal recruitment through associated clinics/hospitals and the discussion explicitly addresses both in-utero and postnatal chemical exposure. The author affiliations and ethics approval identify Hokkaido University CEHS; the cohort website is not cached. The 2021 paper variously says study start 2001 or 2002, but its component recruitment intervals agree with the definition.

label: Hokkaido Study on Environment and Children's Health
detail: The catalogue entries and focused cached-paper search do not establish leadership. Papers identify the centre in author affiliations and ethics approval, which are not statements of operational responsibility.

label: GINIplus/LISA North
detail: This is a regional population pooled from two independently recruited birth cohorts. Review whether an aggregation of the Wesel cohort components is the appropriate model for this combined term.

label: GINIplus/LISA North

label: Walnuts Smart Snack Dietary Intervention Trial
detail: Explicit operational leadership of the trial by ISGlobal researchers.

label: Walnuts Smart Snack Dietary Intervention Trial
detail: Date distinction: the catalogue gives 2016–2017 data collection, whereas PMID:35960396 says participants were recruited over 2015–2016. The protocol originally targeted ages 12–15 but explicitly broadened eligibility to 11–16. The planned 800 and final randomized/analyzed samples are not asserted as a cohort total.

label: Walnuts Smart Snack Dietary Intervention Trial
detail: The new catalogue entries do not name ISGlobal, and a focused cached-paper search does not state the claimed organisational role.

label: GENOBOX study
detail: weak: lower-case cohort variant in a cited title.

label: GENOBOX study
detail: Additional support beyond six quotes: PMID:33171599 explicitly describes principal cardiometabolic risk factors associated with obesity, and PMID:39809640 studies inflammatory biomarkers. The 2022 source places unconfirmed minor gastrointestinal disorders in its case-group recruitment sentence, while common infections define controls; the 2020 paper gives a broader combined recruitment description.

label: Rio Birth Cohort Study on Environmental Exposure and Childhood Development
detail: The 2020 protocol explicitly calls the study hospital-based and designs four-year follow-up. Its pilot interval begins September 2017, while actual enrollment was October–November and the later paper calls October 2017–August 2018 the pilot period. Portuguese coordination and exposure quotes are copied from the project website. The two full PIPAUFRJ names differ only by whitespace. Both listed additional cohort-naming papers were read before consulting other cached name matches.

label: Programming Research in Obesity, Growth, Environment and Social Stressors
detail: Recruitment end date differs between papers: PMID:42225914 gives February 2010, whereas PMID:27843010 gives February 2011. Growth/metabolic-health wording is supported by longitudinal BMI/adiposity and obesity outcomes rather than a single umbrella statement of that purpose. The website separately states that PROGRESS assesses risk factors impacting neurodevelopment.

label: Infants' Environmental Health Study
detail: That IRET at Universidad Nacional enrolled participants or operationally ran the ISA cohort.

label: Infants' Environmental Health Study
detail: Respiratory and maternal outcomes are explicit in the catalogue, while the principal early papers emphasise growth, neurodevelopment, and exposure biomonitoring. The papers describe extensive nearby banana plantations and weekly aerial spraying. The exact institutional leadership claim is stronger than the affiliations alone.

label: Infants' Environmental Health Study
detail: Neither the catalogue descriptions nor a focused cached-paper search explicitly assigns enrollment or operational responsibility to that institution.

label: Multi-Partner Consortium to Expand Dementia Research in Latin America
detail: The label denotes a research/networking consortium, while the definition denotes the population it recruits. Papers support a harmonized recruited cohort, but also describe an umbrella extending existing datasets and coordinating multiple sites. A curator should distinguish the consortium from its study population before deciding whether cohort aggregation is appropriate.

label: Multi-Partner Consortium to Expand Dementia Research in Latin America
detail: PMID:42251497 additionally describes clinical, academic and community recruitment channels and states that the questionnaire evaluates multiple domains of lifelong social exposures. PMID:33776890 describes adapting the UCSF Memory and Aging Center assessment and a launch co-hosted by that centre. EEG is a planned protocol extension in that paper, not established universal baseline collection. Whole-cache exact-case search found ReDLat Study/project only in COHO's own file.

label: Sustainable plant protection transition: a global health approach
detail: The name denotes the wider SPRINT project, while the definition deliberately describes its recruited human cross-sectional field study. Keep that scope distinction explicit; the protocol also includes environmental, plant and animal studies.

label: Sustainable plant protection transition: a global health approach
detail: Further protocol passages define farmer families, neighbours with no professional farming involvement, and consumers farther from fields; describe silicon wristband material and seven-day wear; specify indoor home dust; and set objectives for exposure modelling and health-risk assessment. The protocol uses planned/ongoing collection wording, while the catalogue and example paper document performed sampling.

label: Maule Cohort
detail: Additional verified protocol passages locate Molina in the agricultural Maule Region of Chile; describe the MAUCO Bio-Bank, repeat follow-up visits and a health-surveillance team actively searching public hospitals for events. The profile explicitly locates the county in central Chile. Exact-case whole-cache search found Maule cohort only in COHO.

label: Survey on Health, Well-Being, and Aging in Colombia
detail: That University of Caldas and Universidad del Valle carried out the survey on behalf of the Colombian Ministry of Health and Social Protection.

label: Survey on Health, Well-Being, and Aging in Colombia
detail: The protocol explicitly calls this a cross-sectional study without follow-up. Its fieldwork dates are April–September 2015; the example paper more broadly says 2014–2015. The national Colombian survey should be distinguished from the original multicountry SABE programme and earlier Bogotá survey.

label: Survey on Health, Well-Being, and Aging in Colombia
detail: The catalogue descriptions and focused cached-paper search do not provide this operational statement. The universities are named in ethics approval and bibliographic material, rather than as survey operators for the Ministry.

label: Encuesta Nacional de Situación Nutricional
detail: The definition intentionally covers repeated national cross-sectional surveys, not a longitudinally followed single population. If rounds are modelled as distinct cohorts, this umbrella would require aggregation review.

label: Encuesta Nacional de Situación Nutricional
detail: Pregnant participants are directly documented by PMID:35070447, which states that its analysed sample includes 1,322 pregnant women. The same paper explicitly identifies ENSIN-2015 as cross-sectional. The official site supports public-policy use and gives actual 2015-round fieldwork through December 2016. The malformed 015National catalogue name is retained exactly as tagged; ENSIN 2010/2005 are official website round headings.

label: Cohorts Consortium of Latin America and the Caribbean
detail: The profile also explicitly states that eligible cohorts were asked for anonymized individual-level data and that those records were harmonized and pooled. The 2024 operations paper confirms the regional expert steering committee and Imperial data-server/investigator base. Imperial hosting is time-qualified in the original profile, not an assertion of permanent location.

label: Ecuador Life
detail: Explicit operational responsibility of Laboratorio de Investigaciones FEPIS and St George's, University of London for ECUAVIDA.

label: Ecuador Life
detail: The profile gives November 2006–December 2009 for delivery-based recruitment and planned follow-up to age eight. The additional vaccination paper was read and concerns this same cohort.

label: Ecuador Life
detail: The new catalogue descriptions and focused cached-paper search describe the cohort but do not explicitly state operational responsibility for these institutions.

label: Banco Nacional de Tumores Terry Fox
detail: Tissue collection specifically during surgery and an explicit bank-wide health-research purpose with emphasis on cancer.

label: Banco Nacional de Tumores Terry Fox
detail: The catalogue describes the full donor collection, whereas the two available papers analyse selected cancer populations. PMID:40065011 explicitly identifies INC-C as Instituto Nacional de Cancerología in Colombia. The uppercase Spanish name followed by (BNTTF) was not found as that exact name; the paper instead places the acronym before the Spanish expansion.

label: Banco Nacional de Tumores Terry Fox
detail: The new catalogue descriptions and cited papers establish future research use and cancer-program participation but do not explicitly state collection at surgery or the full bank-wide purpose; the catalogue's Spanish purpose wording occurs in a publication title.

label: China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study
detail: Explicit operational management at the National School of Development of Peking University.

label: China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study
detail: Additional claims are explicitly supported in the profile: respondents are followed every two years by face-to-face CAPI, the study is harmonized with studies in the HRS model, and data are maintained at the National School of Development of Peking University. Its stated purpose includes health/economic adjustments to rapid population ageing.

label: China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study
detail: The new catalogue entries and listed paper do not state management responsibility. Focused cached-paper searches find data maintenance at the National School and interviewer training at Peking University, rather than an explicit operational-management statement for the School.

label: REal-time Assessment of Community Transmission
detail: Age-five eligibility applied to REACT-2 antibody testing; requiring both recontact and linkage consent.

label: REal-time Assessment of Community Transmission
detail: The follow-up REACT Cohort is a population cohort, while the wider REACT programme is a series of studies. Names in this entry cover both scopes; retain cohort only if the term specifically denotes the consented follow-up population.

label: REal-time Assessment of Community Transmission
detail: The protocol and the other two search-added papers were read. REACT-1 collected data from May 2020; the website dates programme launch to April 2020. The primary REACT-2 paper explicitly says children were excluded because its antibody tests were approved for research in adults only.

label: REal-time Assessment of Community Transmission
detail: wrong: The cohort website says "and/or to link to their health data", so it does not require both permissions. PMID:36893367 supports age five for swab sampling; the cached REACT-2 abstract does not give the eligibility age.

label: 3xG study
detail: VITO runs the cohort.

label: 3xG study
detail: The source specifies expected births during 2010–2015 rather than independently documenting every actual date of birth. The additional PFAS paper and glyphosate example were read; they analyse newborn and later childhood subsamples, respectively.

label: 3xG study
detail: Listed catalogue and website sources and a targeted term-mention search give no operational sentence; VITO is visible in the website footer only.

label: Cohort ’18, Growing Up in Hungary
detail: The paper’s abstract gives actual births March 2018–April 2019; its sampling section selected expected delivery dates April 2018–April 2019. Cohort18 is the catalogue identifier, and the institution-bearing long synonym is the catalogue heading. The Hungarian spellings were not found in the cache.

label: COMmunity-based Behavior and Attitude survey in Tuvalu
detail: The papers describe cross-sectional survey waves in 2020, 2022 and 2023, including diet/obesity and sleep-apnoea analyses. The catalogue describes a prospective longitudinal cohort with collection dates 2025–2029 and includes adolescents as well as adults. A direct statement linking the historical waves to the prospective cohort’s continuation is not given; the shared COMBAT identity is documented in the catalogue.

label: COMmunity-based Behavior and Attitude survey in Tuvalu
detail: Catalogue narrative links the cohort to the earlier survey; its design table dates the prospective collection period. This does not establish that every earlier respondent was re-enrolled.

label: São Paulo Western Region Birth Cohort
detail: The example paper is a retrospective cross-sectional analysis using the prospective cohort, not the design of the whole cohort. The catalogue supplies the detailed toxic-stress aims; the paper independently states the environmental/social child-development objective.

label: Next Steps
detail: The profile also explicitly states that ethnic minorities were oversampled. It gives exact birth dates 1 September 1989–31 August 1990 and the population as Year 9 pupils in February 2004.

label: PROMESA cohort study
detail: Actual enrolment beginning in 2021.

label: PROMESA cohort study
detail: The protocol specifies ages two, three and four, and planned recruitment/follow-up rather than completed work. label: BOMA-Bipolar Study
detail: PMID:32231276 evaluated its depression PRSs (PGS000138 and others) in the 23 major depressive disorder cohorts of PGC29-MDD; the 'BOMA' it used is the PGC MDD cohort 'boma' with 586 MDD cases and 1,062 controls (Supplementary Table 21), not the bipolar disorder case-control sample this term describes (BOMA-Bipolar Study, PGC bipolar working group). The paper never mentions bipolar BOMA. The PGS Catalog's cohort 'BOMA' looks conflated with the Bonn/Mannheim MDD sample; a curator should decide whether this example belongs to a separate BOMA MDD cohort term.

label: Moffitt Cancer Center Ovarian Cancer Study
detail: PGS000751 is a prostate cancer score developed (PMID:31226226) from the samples of the prostate cancer GWAS GCST006085 (PMID:29892016). That GWAS's study table lists the Moffitt Prostate Cancer Study (MOFFITT; table row), not an ovarian cancer study, and neither paper names the Moffitt ovarian cancer study or the acronym MOF. The Catalog's Moffitt tag for this score belongs to the Moffitt Prostate Cancer Study (COHO:0002077), not to this term.

label: Wake Forest University Breast Cancer Study
detail: In the Catalog paper the validation study tagged WFBC is the Women Firefighters Biomonitoring Collaborative (its reference 45 is a study of women firefighters in San Francisco), not the Wake Forest University Breast Cancer Study; the cached paper never names Wake Forest. The Catalog's WFBC sample for PGS005378 (PSS012174) appears to have been resolved to the wrong cohort; the example (and the term's PGS subset membership through it) needs review.
